name: Dashboard strip on a decision day
question: On the day the Fed cuts, does the published per-currency dashboard strip carry each meeting period's own level and its own 1w/1m change?
notes: FOMC: on 31-Aug-26 the tickers were not numbered the way the meeting calendar implies, so the change columns follow the tickers' own recorded dates instead. This is normal after an unscheduled meeting; if there has not been one, the calendar in config/meetings.json needs checking.
